citation.authors: Pu SY, Huang YL, Pu CM, Kang YN et al

cited_by.title: Collagen supplements for skin and joints

record.population: Adults in 26 randomised trials of hydrolysed collagen for skin
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of skin hydration and elasticity
record.finding: Collagen supplements improved skin hydration and elasticity compared with placebo. Effects on hydration varied by collagen source and length of use. The authors note several biases in the included trials and call for larger trials.
record.note: Skin type and ethnicity not reported in the abstract.
